name: THT Action Grant / Action Service Project
summary: Two-year on-the-ground conservation grant of up to INR 25 lakh for lesser-known species and habitats needing urgent intervention; organisations apply for the Action Grant and individuals for the Action Service Project.

steps: Presentation to the Jury, if a finalist

eligibility.rule: Organisations: 3 years of on-ground conservation work in India completed by 31 March 2025
Organisations: registered not-for-profit in India (Society, Trust, Section 8 company or 35(1)(ii) institute)
Organisations: registered under Section 12A of the Income-Tax Act, 1961
Organisations: hold an 80G certificate or Section 35(1)(ii) approval
Individuals: not employed by a registered not-for-profit entity in India
Individuals: not on the Board of Trustees or Management Committee of any registered not-for-profit
Organisations: no political or religious affiliations

documents: Memorandum of Association, Articles of Association or Bye-Laws (organisation)
Section 80G/35(1)(ii) exemption and Section 12AB registration certificates (organisation)
Income Tax Returns for FY 2023-24 and 2024-25
Audited financials for FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24 and FY 2024-25 (organisation)

status.quote: Applications for the THT Conservation Grant, THT Action Grant/Action Service Project and THT Research Grant are Closed Now for 2026!

applicant_types.quote: THT Action Grant is open to organisations and Action Service Project is open to individuals.

geography.quote: conservation organisations and individuals, who work to conserve India's natural habitats and native species of flora and fauna

access.quote: Applicants who have successfully submitted their applications are screened by external auditors

effort.quote: Applications will only be accepted through the THT Grant's application portal online, on The Habitats Trust website (www.thehabitatstrust.org/grants).
Applicants who have successfully submitted their applications are screened by external auditors, to check if they meet all the eligibility requirements and pre-requisites for the grants.
The Sub-Jury member(s) and THT team visit shortlisted applicants for field level evaluation and verification at the proposed project's sites.
The finalists have to undergo another in-depth level of due diligence.
The finalists are invited to present their projects to the Jury for the final evaluation.

eligibility.quote: A functional existence of three years (as per the registration certificate) carrying out direct on-ground projects in conservation of India's natural habitats and threatened species must have been completed by the organisation on or before 31st March 2025.

The organisation must be a registered not-for-profit entity in India, such as a Society, Trust, Section 8 (previously Section 25) company, or a registered institute under Section 35(1)(ii) of the Income-Tax Act, 1961.
A CSR-I certificate must be possessed by the organisation.
Registration under Section 12A of the Income-Tax Act, 1961, must have been obtained by the organisation.

An 80G certificate must have been obtained by the organisation. For institutes where the 80G certificate is not applicable, approval by the Central Government under Section 35(1)(ii) of the IncomeTax Act, 1961, will be considered.

Grassroots conservationists applying as individuals, and not employed by any registered not-for-profit entity in India, such as a Society, Trust, or Section 8 (previously Section 25) company, are eligible to apply for this grant.
The applicant should not be part of any Board of Trustees or Management Committees of any registered not-for-profit entity.
No political or religious affiliations are to be held by the organisation applying.

after_award.quote: Bi-annual reports and a final report on the work supported by The Habitats Trust must be submitted by successful applicants as per the reporting cycle and templates provided.

Income Tax Returns for FY 2023-24 and FY 2024-25 Audited Financials for FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24 and FY 2024-25 CV of key personnel FCRA registration certificate (if registered) Compliance checklist Signed and stamped declaration form (as per format).
